title: NBN POI 4NER (Nerang) Cable Replacement Works
current_summary: The planned backhaul cable replacement at the Nerang (4NER) POI has been rescheduled. Upstream notifications now show the maintenance occurring from 2026-09-02T14:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T20:00:00Z (00:00–06:00 AEST on 3 September 2026). One upstream notification for the earlier August window was removed; we are monitoring and will advise of any further changes.

updates.content: We will be conducting planned maintenance on backhaul serving the NBN Nerang (4NER) POI in Queensland. An upstream network provider will replace cabling during a window from 11:00 PM on 10 August to 6:00 AM on 11 August (AEST). During this time, customers with NBN services delivered via this POI may experience service interruptions, potentially for up to 7 hours within the window. No action is required from customers. We will monitor the work and work to minimise impact, and we appreciate your patience.

The planned maintenance start time has been revised. The maintenance window now begins at 12:00 AM (AEST) on 11 August 2026 and finishes at 6:00 AM (AEST) on 11 August 2026. The end time is unchanged. Customers with NBN services handed off at the Nerang (4NER) POI may experience interruptions for up to 6 hours during this window. No action is required.

An upstream notification for this scheduled maintenance has been removed, and a separate upstream notification still lists the work as scheduled (showing a 12:00 AM AEST start on 11 August and a 6:00 AM AEST end). We are monitoring the discrepancy and will update customers when the schedule is confirmed or if the maintenance is cancelled.

A new upstream notification schedules the maintenance for 2026-09-02T14:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T20:00:00Z (00:00–06:00 AEST on 3 September 2026). One upstream notification for the earlier August date was removed. Services handed off at the Nerang (4NER) POI may be interrupted during the revised window.
